### What's in Your Hand?
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-september-10-11637792.html
Passage: Exodus 4:2
Points:
- Moses felt ill-equipped to deliver Israel and argued that God picked the wrong person.
- The staff in Moses' hand represented his everyday livelihood, career, and natural abilities.
- Natural strength and talent must be yielded and surrendered before God can use them.
- Once submitted in obedience, the ordinary shepherd's staff was transformed into the rod of God.
- When we surrender what we hold, the Lord works through us for greater purposes.

### Just What You Have
Author: Kelly McFadden
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/just-what-you-have-homeword-january-16.html
Passage: Exodus 4:1-2
Points:
- Moses responded to God's calling with hesitation, fear, and a series of excuses.
- God did not ask Moses to buy new supplies or fetch a new weapon.
- The Lord chose to work through what Moses already possessed: a shepherd's staff.
- Believers often feel inadequate, yet God provides everything required to fulfill His call.
- Stepping out in faith allows God's strength to work through our perceived limitations.
